## Problem

What is missing or wrong today? Describe the real-world case the format cannot express
well. Please describe the problem before the solution.

## Proposed change

What you propose to add or change in the model, schema and examples.

## Impact

- Is this backward compatible? Does it require a minor or a patch bump?
- Which sections of the specification and which `$defs` in the schema are affected?
- Example document(s) that would exercise the change.

## Alternatives considered

Other shapes you weighed and why you discarded them.
